additional_native_checks: All 256 KISS port/command combinations and all 256 payload byte values
Explicit ci16/cf32/cf64 little/big endian scalar interpretation and shape bounds
SigMF core:offset is an absolute sample index origin, not a byte offset
Missing required datatype, sample rate, integrity hash and version fail closed
Clipping, nonfinite raw values, manifest evidence and frozen A/B contracts
SatYAML original fixtures, Unicode casefold, duplicate name/NORAD ambiguity, malformed YAML isolation
Duplicate YAML keys and nested unsupported object tags fail closed
Metadata and raw FIFO inputs fail without blocking
Catalogue routing requires matching satellite UUID, bounded frequency and unique NORAD/SatYAML identity
scope_boundaries: Standalone Rust runtime; Python used only as development oracle
SigMF implements explicit core complex-IQ input contracts, not an arbitrary extension JSON-schema engine or non-contiguous dataset reader
Raw manifest decode-readiness validation is ported; blind-manifest creation/freezing and research qualification reporting are separate workflows
SatYAML catalogue metadata advertises profile declarations, not verified runtime implementation of every advertised modulation/FEC
Catalogue routing core is ported; legacy file loaders and aggregate report rendering are not this module
Catalogue baud disagreements are typed JSON numbers rather than legacy display strings
waveform_routing.py PSD classification is separate DSP functionality, not implemented here
KISS malformed records are counted and excluded as in the original; successful parsing never asserts telemetry integrity or transmitter attribution
